## Code Review Findings Summary

### Standards Axis
- **Architecture & Conventions**: Conformance to `AGENTS.md` and repository standards (Node.js >= 22 LTS, strict TypeScript mode, `NodeNext` module resolution, Vitest, clean ESLint).
- **Template & Skill Symmetry**: Strict 1:1 byte-for-byte parity is preserved across `templates/prompts/` vs `.github/prompts/`, `templates/skills/` vs `.agents/skills/`, and `templates/docs/AGENTS.template.md` vs `AGENTS.md`.
- **Manifest & Presets**: `agents-manifest.json` and `src/lib/presets.ts` updated to bundle `grill-me` in `standard` and `full` presets.
- **Changelog Hygiene**: Clean entry under `## [1.4.0] -> ### Added` documenting the Inquisitive Agent Fleet & Grilling Protocol and Selective Server-Side Issue Querying with cross-references to PR #54 and issue #55.
- **Fowler Smell Baseline**: Passed. Worktree lifecycle management and daemon worker have clear bounded responsibilities and clean interrupt handlers.

### Spec Axis (PR #54)
- **Selective Server-Side Querying**: Added server-side `gh --search` exclusion filters (`no:assignee -label:measurement -label:needs-human -label:needs-design -label:wontfix -label:needs-info`) and priority-tier filters in Step 8 of `autowork.md` (`templates/prompts/autowork.md` & `.github/prompts/autowork.md`), preventing terminal buffer overruns and context token waste.
- **Inquisitive Fleet & Grilling Protocol**: Added `grill-me` skill (`templates/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md` & `.agents/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md`), Ambiguity & Missing Acceptance Criteria Gate in `autowork.md` Step 12, and Requirements Discovery rules in `AGENTS.md`.
- **Test Invariant Coverage**: Added unit tests in `tests/prompts-validation.test.ts`, `tests/manifest.test.ts`, and `tests/installer.test.ts` asserting invariant definitions and drift compliance.

### Security Pass
- **Auth Gates & Permissions**: Least-privilege permissions blocks maintained across all workflows; token file writes enforce `chmod 600`.
- **Command & Shell Safety**: Process execution uses parameterized array arguments (`spawn` / `execFileAsync`) preventing shell injection. Static search qualifiers prevent prompt injection.
- **Dependency Audit**: 0 vulnerabilities detected across 93 packages (`npm audit`).

### Findings Breakdown
- **Blocking**: None.
- **Non-blocking (Addressed)**: Fixed ESM `require()` call in `src/lib/runner.ts:isAgyInstalled()`; applied changelog issue/PR cross-references.
